entities.name: M1-1 protoxin (P01546)
observations: Exact sequence match to the 316-residue query; reviewed UniProt record from Saccharomyces cerevisiae killer virus M1.
N-terminal signal peptide spans residues 1–26; mature protoxin spans residues 27–316.
Secreted ionophoric K1 killer toxin that binds cell-wall (1->6)-beta-D-glucan and ultimately forms a pore in susceptible target membranes.
Mature toxin is processed into delta, alpha, gamma immunity, and beta chains; alpha and beta chains are linked by three disulfide bonds.
Reference features include transmembrane helices at residues 72–92 and 112–132, plus three disulfide bonds.

entities.name: K1 killer toxin function
observations: The query is a secreted fungal killer toxin protoxin, not a metabolic enzyme; its biological activity is receptor-mediated membrane disruption and pore formation.
Curated annotation assigns carbohydrate binding, toxin activity, extracellular localization, and host-cell membrane association.

entities.name: Query protein sequence properties
observations: Length 316 residues; calculated molecular weight 34,825.8 Da; theoretical pI 5.19; predicted charge at pH 7 approximately -12.6.
The N-terminal hydrophobic segment is consistent with the curated 26-residue signal peptide.
